title: Daily sync to your knowledge base
footer: Every day around {time}, Persona reads what changed in the chats, documents and meeting minutes these accounts can see, and adds it to your knowledge base. Nothing is posted or changed in Lark.
chat_bot_first: Set up the chat bot above first.
tier_docs_hint: Only your documents, sheets, wiki pages and meeting minutes. Work accounts may need an admin to approve this first.
tier_docs_no_chat: This option cannot read chat history (group and direct messages will not sync). Choose "Everything, including chat history" if you want chats synced.
tier_full_hint: Your documents, sheets, wiki pages, meeting minutes, and the chats you are in and their messages. Work accounts usually need an admin to approve this first.
reauth_soon_one: Access ends in {count} day. Authorize again to keep syncing.
reauth_soon_other: Access ends in {count} days. Authorize again to keep syncing.
schedule_hint: When the daily sync starts, in this computer's time.
im_poll_hint: Checks for new messages and shared cloud documents every 15 minutes for accounts that include chat history. The full daily sync still runs once a day.
add_intro: Persona reads Lark through an app you allow to read as you. Create a new one by scanning, or give the chat bot this permission.
add_footer: Use a new bot for an account in another company or another Lark account.
name_hint: Optional, to tell your bots apart.
step_scopes: Step 1 of 2: Give the chat bot permission
step_bot_scopes: Step 1 of 2: Give the bot permission
step_create_footer: Scan with the Lark app and confirm. This page moves on by itself.
step_authorize: Step 2 of 2: Allow reading as you
authorize_browser: Lark opens and asks whether Persona may read as you. Afterwards you come back here.
authorize_device: Scan with the Lark app, or open the link and enter the code, then allow Persona to read as you.
manual_intro: One more thing first: in the app's settings in the Lark developer console, add this address under Security settings › Redirect URLs. Then continue.
qr_label: QR code to scan with Lark
waiting_confirm: Waiting for you to confirm in Lark…
connected_toast: Account connected. The first sync starts soon.
return_done_detail: Persona will read what changed every day and add it to your knowledge base. The first sync starts soon.
return_declined_detail: Persona wasn't allowed to read as you. You can try again from the Lark settings.
return_missing_detail: This page completes connecting a Lark account. Start from the Lark settings.
return_failed_detail: {error} Try again from the Lark settings.
bot_unfinished: Setup wasn't finished. Remove this bot and add it again.
